chunks: Malik ibn Anas said: And I heard al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) say:

It was said to the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him): Why do you not purchase a purebred horse? He said: I have no need for it, for I do not flee from one who attacks me, nor do I attack one who flees from me.

key_terms.فرسا عتيقا: A purebred/highborn horse -- valued in Arab warfare for speed and endurance

ai.seo_question: Why did Imam Ali not need a fast horse?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) quotes Imam Ali (AS) explaining why he did not need a fast horse. Ali's response reveals his martial ethos: he never retreated from an attacker, nor pursued a fleeing enemy. This teaching was shared by Malik ibn Anas, the famous Sunni jurist who studied under Imam al-Sadiq, demonstrating the cross-sectarian respect for the Imam's scholarly circle.

en.bilal-muhammad: Malik b. Anas said: And I heard al-Sadiq (as) say:
It was said to Amir al-Mu’minin (as): Why do you not purchase a highborn horse? He said: I have no need for it, for I do not flee from one who attacks me, nor do I attack one who flees from me.
